tool.name: AddWebsiteField
tool.summary: Parse the JSON-encoded websites (or sources) column of Overture features and add a website text field containing the primary URL.

usage.bullet_item: The input features must contain a websites or sources column with JSON-encoded URL data from Overture Maps.
The tool adds or updates a website text field on the input feature class in place.

param.name: input_features
param.dialogReference: The feature layer or feature class containing a websites or sources column to parse.
